title: Wilds of Eldraine: Enchanting Tales: card flavor text

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A fairy-tale plane ruled by the High Fae and home to knights, witches and fae.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: Styled First and Greatest of the High Fae, Sovereign of the Court and the One True Lord of Eldraine.

entities.name: High Fae
entities.description: Fae rulers of Eldraine whom some mortals consider more than myth.

entities.name: Davin
entities.description: A young would-be knight hoping a young griffin will accept him.

entities.name: Syr Perrin
entities.description: A knight who confesses to wronging a family on a fool's errand and offers himself for their revenge.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch who says she needs no one else.

entities.name: Valtry
entities.description: A merfolk fascinated by the surface who discovers a fallen drywalker at the bottom of Loch Larent.

entities.name: Loch Larent
entities.description: A loch whose bottom is home to merfolk.

entities.name: Jurald
entities.description: A traveler who sees the dark forest light up with a thousand eyes.

entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: A part of the realm that fell to the invaders.

entities.name: Castle Vantress
entities.description: A castle whose hasty defense left it more moat than castle.

entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: A kingdom whose knights fought with the fire of the Irencrag in their hearts.

entities.name: Irencrag
entities.description: A fiery crag whose fire the knights of Embereth carry in their hearts.

entities.name: Torbran
entities.description: A mighty dwarf who struck the invading phalanx like a bolt from the heavens.

entities.name: Cade
entities.description: A figure who embraced the flame with reckless courage and vowed to be remembered.

entities.name: Tugrunn
entities.description: A brawler who threw blow after blow at a creature of solid rock.

entities.name: Korlag
entities.description: An ogre preparing a new 'am bush' strategy.

entities.name: Syr Armont
entities.description: A brave knight who wondered about the true nature of the elves.

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: A keep afflicted by a curse that began to wither when a rose bloomed.

entities.name: Tuinvale
entities.description: A place the rhyme warns travelers not to tarry in, lest the fae seek recompense.

entities.name: Gluttoneers
entities.description: Dwarven survivors named for slaying dozens of redcaps with fruit and cakes.

entities.name: Redcaps
entities.description: Brazen goblin-like creatures feuding with the dwarves.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.description: A people in a long feud with the redcaps, sparked by a dispute over a spoon.

entities.name: Delverhaugh
entities.description: A place assaulted in the feud between dwarves and redcaps.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders under whom parts of the realm fell during a strange eclipse.

events.summary: A merfolk, Valtry, finds a fallen drywalker at the bottom of Loch Larent.
events.quote: The strange new coral was not coral at all, but a fallen drywalker!

events.summary: Locthwain falls to the invaders while the realm's great minds quarrel over a strange eclipse.
Castle Vantress is hastily defended and left more moat than castle.
events.quote: Hasty efforts to defend Castle Vantress left it more moat than castle.

events.summary: The knights of Embereth fight on without retreat, though many fall.
events.quote: Though many fell, not a single one retreated.

events.summary: Torbran strikes the invading phalanx, leaving only ash.
events.quote: When the light faded, only ash remained around him.

events.summary: The curse of Redtooth Keep begins to wither as a rose blooms.
events.quote: the curse of Redtooth Keep began, at last, to wither.

events.summary: Dwarven survivors are dubbed the Gluttoneers for slaying redcaps with fruit and cakes.
events.quote: the dwarven survivors were dubbed the Gluttoneers.

relations.note: Styled First and Greatest of the High Fae, Sovereign of the Court.
relations.quote: First and Greatest of the High Fae, Sovereign of the Court

relations.note: Long feud, sparked by a dispute over a spoon.
relations.quote: The feud between dwarves and redcaps had raged for so long that no one could quite recall how it started.
